title: Ark Story Sequence Cards
purpose: Help children hold together the context, instructions, waiting, and preservation in the flood narrative.
body_markdown:
# Ark Story Sequence Cards

- Before - violence and corruption fill the earth.
- Build - God tells Noah to make an ark and preserve life.
- Wait - Noah, his family, and the animals remain while the waters recede.
- Leave - God tells them to come out and fill the earth again.

## Teacher note

Keep judgment serious but non-graphic. “God remembered” describes faithful action, not divine forgetfulness.
